newsitem.title: THAILAND: Karat to sell two units to Siam City Cement.
newsitem.headline: Karat to sell two units to Siam City Cement.

text.p: Thai porcelain and plastics manufacturer Karat Sanitaryware Plc will sell two operations to Siam City Cement Plc, Karat said in a statement on Tuesday.

Karat said it will sell a plastic pipe manufacturing unit in Prachinburi, south of Bangkok to Siam City Tiles and Pipes Co Ltd, a 99.9 percent subsidiary of Siam City Cement for about 370 million baht ($11.9 million).

Karat will sell a 65 percent stake in its Vietnamese subsidiary Karat Be Song Company Ltd, to Siam City Cement's 99.9 percent owned subsidiary Siam City Cement (Singapore) for 20 million baht ($645,000), the statement said.
Siam City Cement and Karat share a number of senior executives and common shareholders.
